title: West Maui affordable housing project water condition
summary: A Council resolution would change conditions on a West Maui housing project, and the applicant asked to delete condition two, saying it has its own wells and a surface water agreement but is still waiting for state water use permits. The Planning Commission recommended amending condition two with the applicant's wording and keeping condition 15, and its recommendation goes to the County Council.

timeline.text: That motion passed by roll call.
Amendment to the main motion: deny the removal of condition 15: The commission approved an amendment recommending that condition 15 not be removed.
The vice chair moved to recommend amending condition two with the applicant's wording.
The applicant said 300 of the 400 affordable units are rentals and 100 are for sale.
A West Maui resident testified in support of the resolution.
A carpenters union representative testified against the request.
The applicant said the project has two wells, a surface water agreement and a conditional will-serve letter.
The applicant said the project is still waiting for the state water commission to approve its water use permits.
The applicant asked to delete condition two, saying the project already provides its own water source.
The applicant said fire-affected residents, starting with seniors, will get those rentals first.
The applicant said it is working with the County phase by phase to make the project 100% affordable.
The applicant said the project's first phase is now 240 affordable rentals.
The main item was a Council resolution to change conditions on a West Maui housing project.
